    Heat and air quality today

    The heat index and PM2.5 at Tha Prachan now and for the rest of today, and what to do.

    Heat index now

    34°CWarning

    Temperature 29°C, humidity 70%. Reading for 20:45

    What to do: Heat cramps and heat exhaustion are possible. Drink water often and rest in the shade

    PM2.5 now

    11 µg/m³Very good

    What to do: Very good for outdoor activity

    What the levels mean

    Heat index levels, Department of Health
    LevelRangeAdvice
    NormalBelow 27°COutdoor activity is fine
    Caution27 to 32°CLong spells in the sun can tire you out. Drink water often
    Warning(now)33 to 41°CHeat cramps and heat exhaustion are possible. Drink water often and rest in the shade
    Danger42 to 51°CHeat stroke is likely after long spells outside. Avoid outdoor activity in the middle of the day
    Extreme danger52°C and aboveHeat stroke is very likely. Stay indoors somewhere cool
    PM2.5 bands, Pollution Control Department
    LevelRange (µg/m³)Advice
    Very good(now)Up to 15Very good for outdoor activity
    Good15.1 to 25Outdoor activity is fine
    Moderate25.1 to 37.5If you have a health condition, watch for coughing or shortness of breath
    Starting to affect health37.6 to 75Spend less time outdoors. Wear a dust mask when you are outside
    Affects healthAbove 75Avoid outdoor activity. Wear a dust mask outside and see a doctor if you feel unwell

    Where the readings come from

    All values are model estimates from Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0) for Tha Prachan, not station measurements, refreshed every 30 minutes. The PM2.5 bands are set for a 24 hour average, so an hourly value is a guide only.
